digest.component_or_area: rebar LLM model configuration and routing
propositions: Model tier selection is currently inferred from equality tests against default provider rather than expressed as declarative configuration, causing silent downgrades to stop applying across multiple verification paths

A single scalar knob (REBAR_LLM_MODEL) cannot express per-pass model mappings, and bare model names in YAML ladders resolve to direct Anthropic instead of respecting provider context (split-brain: 41/42 calls)

Reserved class names (trivial/standard/frontier) must be resolved at exactly three call sites (config.resolve_model, batch runner ladder expansion, verifier path) without creating a module-level import cycle in config.py

Configuration layering via REBAR_LLM_CONFIG_FILE must deep-merge tables to preserve sibling keys and replace arrays wholesale rather than append, so an override of one class field does not lose discovered provider/endpoint/fallback

Per-pass model ids must cross provider boundaries correctly: Pass-1 calls escalate to frontier model while Pass-2/Pass-4 verifier downgrades dispatch to standard model, regardless of whether they target different providers
Bare model ids in ladders and verifier resolution must never silently fall back to substring-matched Anthropic names; sizing.MODEL_LADDER escalation must return qualified ids, not bare names
